operator-walkthrough.ref: Admin UI v1 Wave 2, what the crew sees on an iPhone after this merges. Open nickstire.org/admin: Today opens on one verdict line ('Now: ...'), then the priority queue as a ruled list, the first row about 265 px down. Each row is 48 px: an urgency dot, the customer name, a one-line detail, the money in tabular figures and one verb (a short verb on phones, the full verb as its accessible name); Call and Text are 48 px icons when there is a phone; the second action sits behind a 48 px overflow button. At most 12 rows show, urgent items first, then 'Show N more'. Tapping a verb acts in place: a booking confirm and a callback complete keep their two-tap confirm; on success the row fades out over 150 ms and the Needs action number drops; on failure the row stays and a toast says why. When every read has answered and the queue is empty the board says 'Done for today. Nothing needs you.' with the time it was checked; if the queue or the work-order read failed it shows the W0 unknown state instead, never the all-clear; while either read is pending it says Loading the queue. Below the board: the four numbers as one strip, Billed, Arrival load, then a 'Checks' rail that is collapsed on a phone and open on a desktop, remembered per device once you toggle it, holding Promises, Inspection, Closed loop, Exceptions, Freshness, the gateway and calls lines and History; its summary counts open items, an overdue promise included, and says 'promises unknown' when that read fails. Customer-facing SMS prefills are unchanged (admin-customer-copy-pins green). Verified by the fixture harness render and the six-feet gate: Today at 390 scores 0.359 against the frozen pre-W1 render (gate 0.35). Tests: client/src/__tests__/admin-w2-today-board.test.tsx and admin-w1-shell; 139 client files / 1,966 tests green on the combined tree. Not device-tested: Nour's own look on his phone is owed after the deploy.
